text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — our joint hands-on microclinic with IntegratorCo is next Wed. Need final run-through + shipping plan for 30 sample kits.
Samir Patel: I have the speaker slide deck v3 ready. Can someone confirm AV requirements?
Lena Brooks: projector + HDMI adapter, mini tripod for demo phone, 1x ethernet per demo station (wifi flaky in that room).
Omar Ruiz: Hardware partner will bring the mini appliance (EdgeBox). they'll need a 20A circuit near the table. cc @Marisol Vega for power plan.
Marisol Vega: Noted. I'll add power and rack space to the vendor manifest. Also arranging a dedicated courier for sample kit returns.
Kai Nguyen: For the IntegratorCo flow, we need OAuth creds for the hosted sandbox. Samir — can you strip PII from the demo dataset?
Samir Patel: Yep, will scrub and push a sanitized export by EOD Friday.
Maya Chen: Timeline: Mon — kits packed & labeled, Tue — courier pickup, Wed morning — on-site AV check at 8:30am, Wed 10:00 — microclinic live.
Tara Gomez: Who's the backup speaker if Lina (IntegratorCo) gets delayed?
Lena Brooks: Omar can cover the demo steps; Samir can cover architecture Q&A.
Marisol Vega: Swag update: stickers + laptop sleeve + 1-page quickstart in each kit. Sleeve supplier just confirmed 30 units.
Maya Chen: Can we include a QR card that pre-fills the workshop feedback form? Small ask but helps follow-ups.
Kai Nguyen: I can generate a short URL and QR SVG. Will post to thread.
Samir Patel: Shipping labels: using Shiply. Command to generate bulk labels attached for ops:```shiply create-batch --order-file kits.csv --service next-day```
deploy-bot: Reminder: create a temporary access token for the sandbox env that expires after 48 hours.
Omar Ruiz: For demos needing GPUs, EdgeBox will advertise model perf; keep fallback to hosted Redwood API if device overheats. Add fallback note to runbook.
Maya Chen: Good call — add fallback policy: if EdgeBox latency > 200ms or error rate > 5% switch to hosted model.
Lena Brooks: Running a short dry-run Fri 11am PST. Can everyone listed join? 30m max.
Marisol Vega: Courier pickup slot reserved Tue 2pm–4pm. Tracking will be uploaded to the shipping sheet.
Kai Nguyen: QR + short URL: https://rwd.link/microclinic — QR SVG uploaded to shared drive.
Samir Patel: Final deck link: https://drive.redwood/repo/microclinic/v3 — comments welcome.
Maya Chen: Thanks — last asks: (1) speaker bios to marketing by Friday, (2) confirm booth power, (3) post-run feedback form link in chat after event.
Tara Gomez: I'll ping marketing and confirm bios tomorrow.
Maya Chen: Awesome — everyone please react with :thumbsup: once your item is done. See you at dry-run.
